parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with very high precordial voltage (deep S in V2-V3, tall R in V4-V5) and lateral T-wave inversion in aVL. The J-point and ST segments are at baseline in the inferior leads, with only broad, tall T waves and no convex or tombstone ST elevation, so STEMI criteria are not met.
